what_this_is: Every execution-capable thing a project repository can name, as one document. The project service's tests build a real repository from this, plant each entry as a program that writes a sentinel file when it runs, and then run a status, a review refresh, a clone and an adoption against it. No sentinel may appear. This is the fixture behind KR-ACC-030, KR-REQ-14.23 and KR-REQ-14.24: argument-vector construction alone is not the isolation, so the isolation is tested by trying to trigger each helper. Two of the entries are not configuration keys of the repository under test: a submodule's own configuration lives in the parent's modules directory, which the parent's configuration listing does not read, and a driver name is case-sensitive and may hold an equals sign, which a command-line `-c` override cannot express. Both are listed under `outside_the_repositorys_own_configuration`.

marker_program.how_it_is_planted: The script is copied into the fixture repository with @SENTINELS@ replaced by an absolute directory on the internal disk. It takes one argument, the name of the entry that invoked it, and appends that name to a file of the same name inside that directory. It exits zero, so a helper that runs does not also fail the command and hide itself. Because it exits zero whatever becomes of its write, the planting runs it once with a name of its own and requires the file it should have left: finding no sentinel afterwards is then evidence that nothing ran, rather than evidence that nothing could be written.

neutralised.git_would_run_it_during: every status and every index refresh
neutralised.how_this_host_stops_it: core.fsmonitor=false as an override no configuration file can undo, plus core.untrackedCache=false and --no-optional-locks so no index is written

neutralised.git_would_run_it_during: a checkout, a clone and a worktree creation
neutralised.how_this_host_stops_it: core.hooksPath points at a directory this host owns and keeps empty, so no hook is ever found, wherever the repository put its own

neutralised.git_would_run_it_during: a status or a diff that reads working-tree content, and any add
neutralised.how_this_host_stops_it: the effective configuration is read first and every filter driver it defines is blanked by name, because the set of driver names is whatever the repository chose
blanked by name with the rest of its driver

neutralised.git_would_run_it_during: a status, a diff or a checkout, as the long-running form of the two above
neutralised.how_this_host_stops_it: blanked by name with the rest of its driver

neutralised.git_would_run_it_during: a diff of a path whose attributes name this driver
neutralised.how_this_host_stops_it: blanked by name, and every diff also passes --no-textconv
diff.external= as an override, and every diff also passes --no-ext-diff

neutralised.git_would_run_it_during: any command whose output would be paged
neutralised.how_this_host_stops_it: --no-pager, core.pager=cat, GIT_PAGER=cat, and a child with no terminal
one empty credential.helper override empties the whole list, including the per-URL entries, and only the approved broker's helper is appended after it
core.sshCommand is set to the approved broker's program, or to nothing when there is no ssh transport

neutralised.git_would_run_it_during: any command that would open an editor
neutralised.how_this_host_stops_it: core.editor=false, sequence.editor=false, GIT_EDITOR=false, and no subcommand that needs one is in the allowlist
core.askPass=, GIT_ASKPASS=, SSH_ASKPASS=, GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 and an empty DISPLAY

neutralised.git_would_run_it_during: a fetch over the git protocol
neutralised.how_this_host_stops_it: core.gitProxy=, and the git protocol is not a transport this host uses at all

serving a fetch from this repository
neutralised.how_this_host_stops_it: uploadpack.packObjectsHook=, which reaches the subprocess too because the overrides travel in the environment and every child Git starts inherits them
every gpg program is set to false, and log.showSignature=false

neutralised.git_would_run_it_during: an init or a clone, which copies the template's hooks into the new repository
neutralised.how_this_host_stops_it: init.templateDir points at an empty directory this host owns, and every clone also passes --template=

neutralised.git_would_run_it_during: a merge of a path whose attributes name this driver
neutralised.how_this_host_stops_it: blanked by name with the other drivers, and no merge subcommand is in the allowlist

refused.why: it names the remote helper program git-remote-planted, and a remote helper is not something a command-line override removes: the operation is refused instead
URL rewriting is multi-valued, so an override adds to the list rather than replacing it; an operation that would resolve a URL through it is refused instead

outside_the_repositorys_own_configuratio.what: a filter driver defined in a submodule's own configuration
outside_the_repositorys_own_configuratio.git_would_run_it_during: any status of the parent that checks a submodule's dirtiness, which runs Git inside the submodule
outside_the_repositorys_own_configuratio.how_this_host_stops_it: the parent's audit cannot see it, so this host never enters a submodule: every read passes --ignore-submodules=all, submodules are counted from the index, and the preview says that what a submodule holds is neither measured nor copied

outside_the_repositorys_own_configuratio.what: a filter driver whose name is mixed case or holds an equals sign
outside_the_repositorys_own_configuratio.git_would_run_it_during: the same reads as any other filter driver
outside_the_repositorys_own_configuratio.how_this_host_stops_it: the audit keeps the bytes the repository chose, because a configuration subsection is case-sensitive, and the overrides travel as GIT_CONFIG_KEY_<n> and GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_<n> rather than as `git -c`, because `-c` splits its argument at the first equals sign

outside_the_repositorys_own_configuratio.what: a driver whose name holds a control character
outside_the_repositorys_own_configuratio.git_would_run_it_during: the same reads as any other filter driver
outside_the_repositorys_own_configuratio.how_this_host_stops_it: the name cannot be carried in an environment value, so the driver cannot be neutralised and the operation is refused rather than run beside it
